Join a lean-by-design, globally recognised B2B SaaS company as the German-speaking specialist for our DACH+ markets. No cold calling, no quotas — just meaningful conversations that help interested people discover how our software makes their work easier, then supporting them brilliantly once they're on board.

You won't be opening the market alone. Our marketing team already brings in German-speaking interest, and our experienced English-speaking sales colleagues handle these leads well. Your edge is simple and valuable: when a German-speaking prospect wants a demo auf Deutsch, or a new client wants onboarding and support in their own language, you're the person who makes that feel effortless — gründlich, verlässlich und auf den Punkt.

 

Join our Rebel Alliance

We're a diverse, remote crew that takes the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be a valued member of our global Client Success team, well supported with the tools, knowledge and people you need to do excellent work. In time you'll learn to work across teams and draw on our collective expertise — and you'll have real backing at every turn to grow into a confident product expert.

 

What you'll do

  • Run German-language demos for warm, interested leads — clearly and confidently

  • Become a product expert (with our support) and answer client and prospect questions accurately

  • Onboard and support clients in German and/or English, setting them up for success from day one

  • Provide responsive, thoughtful support in either German or English

  • Test scenarios carefully so your answers are technically correct, not guessed

  • Report recurring issues to help us improve the product

  • Build trust through honesty, empathy and reliability

 

What you bring (essentials)

  • Native-level German (C2) and strong business English

  • Minimum 3 years SaaS experience in support, onboarding, implementation or technical pre-sales

  • Real technical aptitude. Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, staging vs production, dev console and database queries are familiar — you needn't be a developer, but you should be genuinely comfortable around them and quick to learn the product's technical side

  • A confident communicator, written and spoken, who listens well

  • Comfortable discussing product value and guiding decisions — without the hard sell

  • Highly organised and process-driven; at home in a remote, tool-rich setup

  • Based in EMEA, ideally within DACH or close business-hours overlap (UTC+1/+2)

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with awards, grants, recognition or programme-management workflows

The short version

If you're technically sharp, genuinely enjoy helping people, and want to be the German-speaking specialist our DACH+ clients rely on, we'd love to hear from you. Komm an Bord!

Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • HTML

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment.

  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Mission

SimScale is a browser-based engineering simulation platform on AWS. Our infrastructure team builds and operates the shared cloud foundation that 40+ engineers across 10+ product teams rely on every day.

Product teams own their services end-to-end, including their infrastructure code, monitoring, cloud cost and first response to incidents. We give them a safe and well-documented platform, guardrails and self-service tools. Thus the teams can do routine work themselves, also in production.

  • Owning tools and processes for disaster recovery, including performing regular restore tests

  • Experience with observability, including metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and SLOs/SLIs

  • You can explain trade-offs to engineers in other teams. You help them adopt better practices without unnecessary friction

jobs.description_html:
Wir sind das Rückgrat einiger Non-Profit-Organisationen in Berlin. Wir bauen verlässliche und sichere IT-Lösungen, damit sich Vereine, Stiftungen und NGOs auf das Wesentliche konzentrieren können: ihre Mission. Bei uns baust du IT, die trägt – statt Tickets abzuarbeiten.

Deine Rolle

Du bist bei uns die Person für Microsoft 365 und Intune. Du entscheidest, wie ein Tenant aufgesetzt ist, welche Richtlinien für Konten und Geräte gelten und wie die Daten vom alten Fileserver sauber in SharePoint landen. Bevor bei Kund:innen etwas umgebaut wird, planst du es – von der Bestandsaufnahme über das Zielbild bis zum Cut-over – und setzt es anschließend mit dem Team um. Unser IT-Support arbeitet nach deinen Standards und spiegelt dir, was im Alltag hakt.

Was du bei uns machst

Microsoft 365 & Entra ID

  • Tenants aufsetzen und aufräumen: Rollen, Lizenzen, Gruppen, Gastzugriffe und klare Namenskonventionen

  • Exchange Online betreuen: Postfächer, Verteiler, Mail-Flow, Spam- und Phishing-Schutz, SPF, DKIM und DMARC

  • SharePoint und Teams so strukturieren, dass Seiten, Bibliotheken und Berechtigungen auch in zwei Jahren noch verständlich sind

  • Identitäten absichern: MFA, Conditional Access, Notfallkonten und Rechtekonzepte in Entra ID

Intune & Endgeräte

  • Windows-Geräte über Intune verwalten: Konfigurations- und Compliance-Richtlinien, Updates und App-Rollouts

  • Geräte-Rollouts und Windows-11-Umstellungen planen und durchziehen, gern mit Autopilot

  • Microsoft Defender for Business einrichten und Meldungen bewerten

  • Apple-Geräte einbinden, wo Kund:innen gemischt arbeiten, über Intune und Apple Business Manager

Migrationen & Projekte

  • Bestandsaufnahmen bei Kund:innen durchführen und daraus ein Zielbild entwickeln: Wo soll die IT in ein bis zwei Jahren stehen?

  • Umzüge planen und umsetzen: vom Fileserver nach SharePoint, von Google Workspace zu Microsoft 365, von Tenant zu Tenant oder raus aus dem lokalen Active Directory

  • Den Plan selbst mit umsetzen: Testlauf, Cut-over am Wochenende, Rückfallebene und Nachbetreuung der Nutzer:innen

  • Konzepte so aufschreiben, dass Geschäftsführung und Vorstand entscheiden können: mit Varianten, Kosten und Risiken

  • Aufwände realistisch schätzen und Angebote gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung vorbereiten

Copilot, KI & Automatisierung

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot und andere KI-Tools bei Kund:innen einführen – mit aufgeräumten Berechtigungen, Vertraulichkeitsbezeichnungen und geklärtem Datenschutz

  • Wiederkehrendes automatisieren: PowerShell, Microsoft Graph oder Power Automate

Support & Schulung

  • Zweite Eskalationsstufe für alles rund um Microsoft 365 und Endgeräte – vor Ort in Berlin

  • Technische Entscheidungen verständlich begründen, auch gegenüber Geschäftsführungen ohne IT-Hintergrund

  • Kurze Security- und Anwendungsschulungen für Mitarbeitende unserer Kund:innen

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du arbeitest überwiegend vor Ort: im Büro in Schöneberg und ab und an bei unseren Kund:innen in Berlin, dazu bis zu 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche.

  • Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker:in Systemintegration oder mindestens zwei Jahre Praxis in der Administration

  • Fundierte Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 auf Administrationsebene: Tenant-Struktur, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Intune: Richtlinien, Compliance, App-Rollouts – du definierst Standards, statt sie nur anzuwenden

  • Du denkst erst in Konzepten, dann in Klicks: Du hast schon eine Microsoft-365-Migration oder ein größeres Geräte-Rollout selbst geplant und durchgezogen und kannst das verständlich aufschreiben

  • Verantwortungsvoller Umgang mit KI: Du nutzt KI-Tools gern und prüfst ihre Ergebnisse, bevor sie bei Kund:innen landen. Du führst kein Skript aus, das du nicht verstehst, und gibst Kundendaten nur in freigegebene Tools

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Du erklärst Technik klar, freundlich und mit Geduld

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit Autopilot, Defender for Business oder Microsoft Purview

  • Tenant-zu-Tenant-Migrationen oder das Ablösen von Entra ID Hybrid-Setups

  • Berührungspunkte mit Google Workspace oder Apple-Geräteverwaltung

  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft-Lizenzen für gemeinnützige Organisationen und Berührungspunkte mit Non-Profit, NGO oder Stiftung

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest, wie unsere Microsoft-365-Standards aussehen – kein Konzern-Freigabeprozess

  • Kleines, wachsendes Team mit kurzen Wegen

  • KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag: bereitgestellt und erwünscht, mit klaren Regeln

  • Einladendes Büro (guter Kaffee!) in Berlin-Schöneberg und 1–2 Homeoffice-Tage pro Woche für Konzepte, Doku und Skripte

  • Bezahlte Fortbildungen, etwa für Microsoft-Zertifizierungen

  • Regelmäßig gemeinsam raus – Teamreise in die Berge oder ans Meer

  • Deutschlandticket oder Gym-Mitgliedschaft, dazu 50 € Sachbezug im Monat

Memmingen | Vollzeit | ab sofort | Vergütung nach Erfahrung und Verantwortungsumfang

Automotive × Data Engineering × Software × Innovation

unbefristete Anstellung bei Reisacher

jobs.description_html:
Du suchst eine strategische Rolle mit Product Fokus in einem Tech-Startup? Du willst Teil unserer Mission sein, den Weiterbildungsmarkt zu revolutionieren und eine Plattform zu bauen, die Menschen eine neue Perspektive gibt und sie auf ihrem beruflichen Weg unterstützt? Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast ein Gespür für großartige digitale Produkte und willst mit KI etwas Neues schaffen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Die Arbeitswelt verändert sich tiefgreifend. Für viele Menschen wächst damit die Unsicherheit: Wird mein Beruf morgen noch gebraucht? Welche Fähigkeiten werden wichtig? Und wie finde ich meinen Platz? Weiterbildung ist ein Schlüssel, damit Menschen diesen Wandel mitgestalten können und neue Perspektiven gewinnen.

Mit GenauMeinKurs wollen wir ihnen dabei als verlässlicher Partner zur Seite stehen. Wir wollen Orientierung geben, alle verfügbaren Informationen verständlich zusammenführen und Menschen helfen, den bestmöglichen nächsten Schritt ihrer beruflichen Entwicklung zu finden.

Über uns

Wir sind Edtelligent, ein Tech-Unternehmen aus München mit rund 20 Mitarbeitenden. Wir sind gebootstrappt und profitabel. Unser Gründerteam hat bereits mehrere erfolgreiche Unternehmen aufgebaut und skaliert.

Wir haben bereits eine Software für den Weiterbildungsmarkt entwickelt, die von über 100 Bildungsanbietern genutzt wird, um ihre Kurse zu verwalten. Dadurch bringen wir eine umfangreiche Datenbasis und ein tiefes Verständnis des Weiterbildungsmarktes mit.

Jetzt wollen wir diese Expertise nutzen, um mit GenauMeinKurs eine Plattform für Weiterbildung zu bauen, die den Endnutzer im Fokus hat. Wir entwickeln einen digitalen Begleiter, der Menschen von der ersten Orientierung bis zur passenden Entscheidung unterstützt.

GenauMeinKurs ist ein zweiseitiger Marktplatz: Für Nutzer ist die Plattform kostenlos, Bildungsanbieter zahlen für qualifizierte Anfragen. Beides zusammenzubringen ist ein zentraler Teil deines Jobs. Du entwickelst ein Produkt, dem Menschen vertrauen, weil es ihnen bei ihrer Entscheidung hilft, und das gleichzeitig für Bildungsanbieter so wertvoll ist, dass ein tragfähiges Geschäft entsteht.

Aufgaben

Gemeinsam mit unserem Co-Founder und CTO Stefan und kleinen Team von erfahrenen Entwicklern entwickelst Du GenauMeinKurs zu einem vertrauenswürdigen Begleiter für den nächsten beruflichen Schritt. GenauMeinKurs ist seit Herbst 2026 live und wird bereits von einer vierstelligen Anzahl von Nutzern monatlich genutzt - wir stehen noch am Anfang und du kannst entscheidend mitprägen, wohin sich das Produkt entwickelt.

In deiner Rolle verbindest du analytische Arbeit mit praktischer Umsetzung: Du denkst strategisch und bringst Eigeninitiative, Drive und Lernbereitschaft mit – wir bieten dir den Einblick, den Gestaltungsspielraum und die Unterstützung, um mit deiner Verantwortung zu wachsen.

Konkret bedeutet das:

jobs.description_html:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 15,000 customers, including McDonalds, Michaels, Cintas, Redimix, and U.S. LBM, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 16 million managed assets and 92 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on our Customer Growth Marketing team, inside the account-based marketing (ABM) program that drives site expansion within our existing Enterprise and Mid-Market customers.. You will run the campaigns that introduce MaintainX to new sites and departments, keeping the expansion pipeline growing as targets rise.

The role

You will own the execution behind our ABM programs, so we reach more of our named accounts with timely, relevant campaigns.

  • Run our paid ABM programs on LinkedIn and programmatic: build audiences from account lists and signals, shift budget and creative based on engagement, and test new channels as budget grows. Plan and launch coordinated campaigns across webinars, events, email, and direct mail, timed to account activity and Sales priorities, so Sales has a relevant touchpoint when an account shows buying signals.

  • Set up and QA campaigns in our ABM and marketing tools, and keep account and contact data clean so we reach the right people.

  • Write briefs for ads and landing pages for Creative and keep a refresh calendar, so no campaign goes stale.

  • Report on campaign results and bring your own ideas for one-to-few and one-to-one account plays, so we can go after more high-value accounts.

You will work closely with our Senior Manager, ABM, who sets strategy and signal design, and partner with Sales, Customer Success, Events, and Content. Within 6 to 12 months, you will run our paid programs independently, own your pipeline KPIs, and have designed account plays of your own.

About you

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with hands-on paid digital, ABM, or demand generation experience

  • Experience managing paid campaigns, ideally on LinkedIn and programmatic, and optimizing for pipeline quality rather than volume

  • A track record of executing multi-channel campaigns end to end, ideally ABM campaigns

  • Working knowledge of Outreach (or similar) and Salesforce

  • Strong project management across many campaigns and deadlines at once

  • Comfort pulling performance data, spotting trends, and explaining what they mean

  • Initiative and comfort with ambiguity: you do well in a high-growth environment where priorities pivot

Nice to have:

  • Experience with ABM or sales intelligence tools (UserGems, ZoomInfo, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense)

  • Experience with direct mail or other offline ABM tactics

  • Background in industrial or operations software

We offer

  • Work in the physical world. The accounts you target run factories, fleets, and facilities, and when our software works, their lines stay up.

  • A product the industry already loves. Customers who choose us renew and expand, so you are building on something that already wins.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. MaintainX is part of Autodesk Operations Solutions (AOS), which brings Autodesk’s global reach to the problem we were already solving.

  • An early seat. This program is scaling fast, and the account plays we have not had capacity to run are yours to design.

Values and how we work

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We hire for what you have shipped, not what your title was. You get autonomy and the trust to use it, and we expect you to bring ideas rather than wait to be asked. Priorities shift in a company growing this fast, and we say so openly.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients.

Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers.

We're hiring Technical Support Specialists to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but build the systems that eliminate them, design how AI handles conversations, and turn customer patterns into product priorities.

You might’ve been the person on a team who builds the dashboards, automations, or workflows that make everyone else better from a Support, Implementation, CS Ops, or Analyst seat. Now you want to formalize that work as the role itself. As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't how many cases you closed; it's how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases. Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter.
  • Build and own AI quality. Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain.
  • Synthesize and partner with Product/Eng. Produce formal weekly and monthly insights, participate in roadmap conversations with Product Development teams, and mentor Associates on their build and synthesis work.

What success looks like in your first 6 months

  • Shipped 3–5 AI solutions
  • A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume
  • Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster
  • You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it.
  • You build with AI to make yourself and the teammates around you faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and turning one-off builds into reusable patterns Associates can run with.
  • Mentors Associate teammates on AI builds and pattern synthesis

Professional Qualifications

  • 0-4+ years of relevant experience inSupport, Implementation, CS Ops, embedded data analyst, or AI/automation tinkerer in any field.
  • A concrete portfolio of things you've built or shipped: prompt-engineered systems, dashboards, automations — with evidence of outcomes
  • Strong customer-facing communication and trust-building skills
  • Pattern recognition and synthesis muscle
  • AI-native default. Reaches for AI tools first, treats ambiguity as the work rather than a blocker, and wants to learn how to configure and supervise these systems — not just use them
  • A deep desire to drive results for our customers, with high ownership over the outcomes you own
  • Curiosity and natural problem-solving instincts
  • An instinct to raise the bar for the teammates around you — teaching others to build and synthesize, not just modeling it yourself

Show us your work

Along with your application, in a cover letter send us:

  1. 2–3 things you've built or shipped that changed a metric or outcome — what you made, who it was for, why did you need to do it, and what changed.
  2. A short story about a time your analysis or insight changed a decision someone else made.

Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Role context

This role sits on the Demand Generation team, where SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization) is a fast-growing source of pipeline. Buyers now ask ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's AI Overviews which maintenance software to consider, and our job is to make sure MaintainX is in that answer and described well. Today the work is run by one person. You'll help make it a team of two.

The role

  • You will turn our SEO and GEO strategy into shipped work, so MaintainX shows up wherever buyers search.

  • Run content refreshes and gap pieces from brief to QA to publish, so priority pages recover and hold their rankings and AI citations.

  • Review backlink and offsite citation prospects to keep every link we earn high quality.

  • Support technical SEO and keyword research, flagging issues and opportunities before they cost us traffic.

  • Be the day-to-day contact for our web, design, content and product teams and outside vendors, turning their requests into clear next steps and following through until the work ships.

  • Design and run experiments with our Senior SEO/GEO Specialist to learn what moves visibility in LLMs, and document what you find.

Most of your partners don't own SEO, so part of the job is explaining why a change matters so they want to make it. Our Senior Specialist will train you on our tools and processes and mentor you. Within 6 to 12 months, you'll own execution on the team's core projects, handle ad hoc requests independently, and propose experiments of your own.

About you

  • 1 to 2 years in SEO, through a role or a strong internship

  • Hands-on keyword research and rank tracking in Semrush, Ahrefs or a similar tool

  • A clear view of how search is changing, including how LLMs surface and cite sources

  • Tests you've run or contributed to, and what you learned from them (side projects exploring GEO count)

  • Experience explaining technical ideas to non-technical teammates and getting them on board

  • The organization to juggle several projects and follow up until each is done

  • Comfort making decisions without a clear answer, because search rarely offers one

  • Nice to have

  • Screaming Frog or other technical audit tools

  • Exposure to GEO and AEO tools such as Profound or AirOps

  • B2B SaaS or demand generation experience

We offer

  • A product worth recommending. Operations teams in factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses already choose MaintainX, so you'll be earning visibility for something customers love.

  • An early seat. GEO is new and our team is small. You'll own real projects from week one and learn from the person who built the playbook.

  • Autodesk scale, same mission. As part of Autodesk, we have more resources and reach, pointed at the problem we were already solving.

  • Room to grow. Search is being rewritten right now, and the people who learn it early become the people the company asks.

We reward output and promote quickly when people deliver. We test, measure and share what we learn, including what didn't work. You get autonomy, and we expect you to ask early when you're stuck.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

At Elation, our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life. We are a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform on a mission to enable every patient to receive the highest quality of care. Since inception, we’ve been focused on building a delightful, world‑class customer experience that empowers physicians to focus on delivering phenomenal care to patients.

Elation Health is looking for a Senior Manager, Training & Enablement to build and lead a dedicated function that strengthens how our employees and customers learn.

As Elation grows, we’re investing in a coordinated, scalable approach to training and education. You’ll lead a small, nimble team and own internal learning programs for Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Onboarding, Support, and other teams. You’ll also set the direction for customer education, partnering with customer-facing leaders to develop programs for new and existing customers.

This is a hands-on leadership role with the opportunity to shape the function’s strategy, programs, and ways of working. You’ll coach your team while staying directly involved in curriculum development, content creation, and training delivery.

This role reports to the Director of Product and Customer Marketing and works closely with leaders and subject matter experts across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Build and lead the function

  • Establish a training and enablement strategy aligned with company goals and functional priorities.
  • Lead needs analysis: identify performance gaps, determine where training will have the biggest impact, and prioritize from that analysis rather than primarily responding to requests for courses.
  • Evaluate existing programs and resources, identify opportunities to strengthen them, and develop a roadmap for growth.
  • Manage and develop a small team, setting clear priorities, responsibilities, and quality standards.
  • Establish consistent processes for training requests, program development, and content maintenance.

Develop and deliver internal learning programs

  • Own role-based onboarding and ongoing training for customer-facing teams, adapting content to each audience’s responsibilities.
  • Collaborate with commercial leaders to develop training that supports their commercial strategy and priorities.
  • Design and facilitate live and on-demand learning covering products, workflows, launches, and role-specific skills.
  • Partner with functional leaders and subject matter experts to translate complex information into clear, actionable instruction.
  • Reinforce learning after the session through hands-on practice, job aids, manager coaching resources, and train-the-trainer programs so new skills hold up on the job.

Expand customer education

  • Support the customer education strategy and roadmap, in partnership with the teams that deliver customer onboarding and training today, so priorities are clear and content is not duplicated.
  • Build a mix of live sessions and self-guided content tailored to different customer roles and experience levels, and set the standard for how customer education content is produced and kept current.
  • Use customer questions and feedback to keep education relevant as our products and customers’ needs evolve.

Improve how we work and measure success

  • Use AI to accelerate content development and program maintenance while maintaining accuracy and quality.
  • Develop tools and workflows that make learning resources easy to find, use, and keep current.
  • Measure behavior change, not just completion. Use learner feedback, assessments, on-the-job application, and business outcomes to show where learning is changing how people work and where it is not.

Priorities for the First 6-12 Months

This role spans strategy, people management, content development, and customer education. In the first year, the emphasis is on:

  • Establish a needs-driven approach. Assess existing programs and requests across customer-facing teams, identify the biggest performance gaps, and set priorities from that analysis rather than from the queue of course requests.
  • Rebuild onboarding for priority roles. Focus first on the highest-volume customer-facing roles, with practice, reinforcement, and manager coaching built in from the start.
  • Stand up the function. Build and develop the team, define how training requests are triaged and prioritized, and set quality and maintenance standards for content.
  • Set the customer education direction. Agree with customer-facing leaders on what this role owns versus what stays with the teams delivering customer education today, and build the roadmap from there.
  • Establish measurement. Define how we will track behavior change and business outcomes so we can show impact within the first year.

What We’re Looking For / Professional Qualifications

  • Training and enablement experience. 7+ years of experience in training, learning and development, enablement, or a related field, including 2+ years managing and developing a team. You’re willing to contribute directly to content creation and delivery.
  • Experience across customer-facing and commercial teams. A track record of developing and leading training for multiple functions, such as Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Onboarding, and Support.
  • Healthcare technology experience. Experience working in healthcare SaaS or healthcare technology.
  • Needs analysis and performance consulting. You start with the performance gap, not the course request, and you can show how you decided where training would have the biggest impact.
  • Demonstrated learning design expertise. You can structure effective learning experiences, engage different audiences, and help people apply what they learn on the job. A formal instructional design background is not required, but proven learning design work is.
  • A builder’s mindset. You’ve launched or significantly expanded programs or functions, translating business needs into practical solutions that scale.
  • Cross-functional influence. You build trusted relationships, draw on subject matter expertise, and align stakeholders around shared priorities.
  • Practical AI fluency. You have experience using AI in your work and can assess where it adds value and where human judgment is essential.
  • Adaptability and initiative. You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, anticipating needs, and adjusting plans as new opportunities emerge.

Nice to Have

  • Formal training or certification in instructional design or adult learning.
  • Experience developing external customer education programs.
  • Experience with EHR and revenue cycle management (RCM) technology.
  • Familiarity with learning management systems and content authoring tools, and revenue intelligence platforms such as Gong.

What you’ll do at Jamf:

At Jamf, we empower people to be their best selves and do their best work. The Senior Enterprise New Logo Account Executive (Government) is a strategic enterprise hunter responsible for driving net-new logo acquisition across federal, state, and local government agencies.

This is a pure new logo role, focused on identifying, targeting, and closing net-new public sector accounts. You’ll navigate complex government buying environments, align to mission-driven outcomes, and secure high-value contracts that establish long-term, compliant partnerships.

For those candidates who live near a Jamf office, you may be expected to work periodically in-office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter. For those candidates who are not near a Jamf office, this role may be offered as remote.

What you can expect to do in this role:

Government New Logo Acquisition

  • Build and execute a territory strategy focused on landing net-new government agencies (Federal, SLG, or Tribal) within an assigned segment.
  • Develop deep public sector expertise — including procurement vehicles, budget cycles, compliance frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP, CJIS, StateRAMP), and agency mission priorities.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound, public sector events, partner collaboration, and targeted ABM campaigns aligned to government personas.
  • Engage multi-layered stakeholder groups including IT, Security, Procurement Officers, Contracting Officers, Program Owners, and executive leadership.
  • Align Jamf’s value to mission outcomes such as cybersecurity posture, digital transformation, workforce mobility, and compliance mandates.

Public Sector Deal Execution & Procurement Navigation

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with agency leaders, aligning Jamf solutions to mission-critical initiatives and regulatory requirements.
  • Deliver executive-level presentations and business cases tied to public sector priorities: security, compliance, cost efficiency, and operational effectiveness.
  • Partner closely with Apple’s public sector teams, system integrators (SIs), resellers, and contract holders to drive joint pipeline and win strategies.
  • Leverage partner ecosystems to access contract vehicles and accelerate time-to-award.

Executive Engagement & Partner Ecosystem

  • Build multi-threaded C-suite relationships early, before formal buying processes start — never rely on a single thread.
  • Position yourself as a trusted advisor on Apple enterprise management and endpoint security, bringing a segment-informed point of view.
  • Deliver executive presentations and ROI business cases tied to board-level priorities: security posture, workforce productivity, compliance, and TCO.
  • Own strategic relationships with Apple's enterprise team and key channel/SI partners, with joint business planning that creates a durable pipeline.

Forecasting, Pipeline & Market Intelligence

  • Maintain a strong, qualified pipeline with accurate forecasting and disciplined deal progression in Salesforce.
  • Develop and share public sector intelligence: budget trends, policy changes, competitive positioning, and procurement insights.
  • Contribute to government GTM strategy, including ICP refinement, messaging, and vertical playbooks.
  • Mentor peers on public sector selling strategies, procurement navigation, and enterprise deal execution.

What we are looking for:

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record of quota attainment. (Required)
  • Proven success selling into government/public sector accounts (Federal or SLG), including net-new logo acquisition. (Required)
  • Deep understanding of public sector procurement processes, contract vehicles, and budgeting cycles. (Required)
  • Experience navigating compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, CJIS, StateRAMP, or equivalent. (Preferred)
  • Expertise in managing complex, multi-stakeholder government sales cycles, including contracting and procurement officers.
  • Proficiency in MEDDPICC (or similar) applied to long, complex public sector deals.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to align solutions to mission-driven outcomes.
  • Experience working with channel partners, resellers, and system integrators in the public sector ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with endpoint management, Apple ecosystem, or security technologies (preferred).
  • Executive presence with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical government stakeholders.
  • Highly self-motivated and effective in navigating long, ambiguous, and highly regulated sales cycless

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

Headquarters: United States

Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Opportunity

What if your next product role wasn't just an opportunity to build a better product, but an opportunity to help define the future of an industry?

At TRM Labs, we're building technology that helps the world's leading financial institutions, governments and law enforcement agencies combat financial crime and safeguard the future of finance.

As a Lead Product Manager, you'll operate with an entrepreneurial mindset, identifying new market opportunities, shaping product strategy and building solutions to problems that don't yet have established answers.

We're looking for someone who thinks like a founder. Someone who can connect emerging technologies, customer needs and commercial opportunities to determine not only what we should build, but where we should go as a business.

You'll operate at the intersection of AI, blockchain, intelligence and financial technology, working alongside exceptional technical and domain experts to turn ambitious ideas into products with meaningful global impact.

This is an opportunity to expand your influence beyond traditional product management and develop the capabilities of a business and product leader.

The Impact You'll Have

  • Own the vision, strategy and outcomes of a strategically important product area.

  • Identify emerging market opportunities and develop conviction around where TRM should invest.

  • Lead zero-to-one product development and scale existing products into new markets and use cases.

  • Shape how AI and emerging technologies can fundamentally transform customer workflows and outcomes.

  • Build deep relationships with customers and industry leaders to anticipate needs before they become obvious.

  • Partner with executive leadership to influence strategic priorities and investment decisions.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Design, Intelligence, Data Science and GTM.

  • Influence commercialization, product positioning, pricing and market expansion strategies.

  • Establish clear success metrics and take accountability for customer adoption, product performance and business impact.

  • Elevate the broader Product organization through exceptional product judgment, mentorship and leadership by example.

What We're Looking For

  • A demonstrated track record of building and scaling complex, high-impact technology products.

  • Experience owning product strategy and influencing significant business outcomes.

  • Evidence of identifying new market opportunities and translating them into successful products.

  • Exceptional strategic judgment, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and make high-conviction decisions with incomplete information.

  • Strong commercial acumen and an understanding of market dynamics, competitive positioning and business models.

  • Deep technical curiosity and the ability to partner with exceptional engineering and data science teams.

  • Demonstrated AI fluency, including the ability to identify opportunities where AI can fundamentally transform products and workflows.

  • The ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment without relying on formal authority.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, exceptional execution and a willingness to challenge conventional thinking.

Why Join TRM?

  • Think like a founder. Help identify new opportunities, shape product strategy and build meaningful parts of a growing business.

  • Influence the trajectory of a company. Work on strategically important problems where your decisions can have an outsized impact.

  • Build AI with real-world consequences. Apply emerging technologies to complex, high-stakes problems where accuracy, trust and customer outcomes matter.

  • Expand your leadership capabilities. Develop the strategic, commercial and operational judgment of a future product executive, GM or founder.

  • Leave a meaningful legacy. Help build technology that protects people and institutions for generations to come.

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000.

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Headquarters: Philippines

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Everything we build now runs through one question: how do we supercharge productivity with AI?

ClickUp Brain and our agentic AI capabilities are the center of gravity for the company. We're not bolting AI onto a project management tool, we're building the platform where AI does real work: drafting, summarizing, routing, researching, and executing alongside the humans who use it. That focus is external and internal. We expect our customers to get radically more productive with AI, and we expect the same of ourselves. Every ClickUp employee is given the tools, the training, and the mandate to use AI in their daily workflow.

 

This is an AI-native role. You will use AI every day to research faster, personalize at scale, prep calls, and keep your pipeline clean. You will also be selling AI, so you need to speak about it credibly.

 

The Role

As a Market Development Representative (MDR), you'll serve as the critical bridge between our marketing efforts and the sales team, playing a pivotal role in accelerating our revenue pipeline. You will be responsible for meticulously following up on, nurturing, and qualifying all inbound leads generated from our diverse marketing channels. This role is fundamental to ensuring our sales team engages only with the most promising and well-prepared prospects.

 

In this position, you'll act as the first point of contact and a trusted educator for potential customers. Your mission is to understand their initial interest, assess their business needs, and articulate the value of our platform, including how our AI capabilities change what their team is capable of. You will manage the crucial early stages of the buyer's journey, building rapport and filtering for high-potential opportunities before seamlessly transitioning them to an Account Executive.

 

This is a high-velocity motion: sub-30 day cycles, pipeline generation at scale, and relentless execution. MDRs don't win by out-strategizing over weeks. They win by out-hustling, out-qualifying, and out-persisting, turning every inbound signal into a qualified opportunity that sticks downstream.

 

How We Hire, Coach and Measure: The Four Pillars

Every MDR is developed and evaluated against four behavioral pillars. They're not corporate values on a wall, they're the operating system of the team.

 

🔥 Ownership. The non-negotiable foundation. Extreme ownership of pipeline outcomes and no excuses when a lead goes cold because you didn't respond fast enough or log your work properly. Intellectual honesty: truth over ego. Going above and beyond for the team's collective success, not just your own number.

 

⭐️ Obsession. The refusal to plateau. This is a high-rejection motion, so you study objection patterns, perfect talk tracks, and learn from every no. You compound knowledge: every call makes the next one better because you document what works and share it.

 

⚡️ Effectiveness. Winning by design, not effort alone. Converting high volume into high quality through sharp qualification, deep discovery, and meetings that actually stick. Every touch is chosen for maximum conversion impact.

 

🤖 AI Native. Using AI to amplify your own output, and positioning ClickUp's AI credibly to prospects. The bar: you're leveraging AI across research, outreach, follow-up, and CRM hygiene, and you can articulate our agentic AI value proposition in every qualification conversation.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond promptly (Zoom, phone, email) to all inbound leads generated by marketing activities: handraisers, account signals, content, webinars, social campaigns, and events.

  • Qualify marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) using a consistent framework to determine sales readiness and fit, and distinguish buyers from browsers.

  • Nurture leads through in-depth conversations, acting as an educator and advisor rather than focusing solely on immediate conversions.

  • Uncover real business pain beneath surface-level inquiries, quantify its impact, and document it clearly for the AE.

  • Position ClickUp's platform and agentic AI capabilities credibly and specifically, mapping them to the prospect's actual workflow gaps.

  • Use AI tools across your entire workflow: account and persona research, personalization at scale, call prep, follow-up drafting, and CRM hygiene. Edit every output for authenticity, never ship raw.

  • Maintain accurate, real-time records of lead interactions and qualification status in CRM.

  • Deliver comprehensive AE handoffs with a qualification summary, roles identified, pain documented, and competitive context.

  • Provide detailed feedback to sales and marketing on lead quality, content effectiveness, and channel performance, helping refine messaging and targeting.

  • Occasionally perform cold outreach as needed, with a primary focus on inbound.

  • Share what works: talk tracks, AI workflows, and objection patterns. Individual wins are good, team adoption is better.

 

Qualifications

This role is built for a highly motivated and tenacious individual who is eager to succeed and thrives on hard work. The most important qualifications are your personal drive and resilience, as you'll be connecting with a high volume of customers daily.

  • What's non-negotiable: a strong work ethic, the grit to overcome challenges, and the tenacity to consistently engage with customers.

  • Also non-negotiable: genuine curiosity about AI and a willingness to rebuild how you work around it. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be someone who reaches for AI first and figures it out.

  • 1-2 years of relevant experience in outbound sales and/or a demonstrated passion for sales as a primary career focus.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to quickly build rapport and trust.

  • Analytical mindset with real attention to detail.

  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools.

  • Collaborative team player with a proactive approach to problem-solving. AI adoption spreads through people who are approachable and generous with what they learn.

Success Metrics

  • Speed and quality of lead follow-up against SLA.

  • Conversion rate of MQLs to sales-qualified opportunities.

  • CRM data integrity and process adherence.

  • Quality and usefulness of feedback provided to marketing and sales.

  • Contribution to pipeline and revenue growth from marketing-generated leads.

 

The throughline for this role: speed, resilience, and conversion quality. You win by out-hustling, out-persisting, and out-qualifying every single day, and by using AI to make every one of those things easier than it was yesterday.
